{#- WI-002282: the Leave Form a signed paper copy is taken from. AC1 makes this an Approved-only document. The guard is here rather than on the print menu because this is the only place that covers every route to a PDF - the print view, the download, an email attachment and the API all render this template, and a menu that merely hides the entry blocks none of them. -#} {%- if doc.workflow_state != "Approved" -%} {{ frappe.throw(_("The Leave Form can only be printed once the Leave Application is Approved. This one is {0}.").format(doc.workflow_state or _("not submitted"))) }} {%- endif -%}
{%- if pow_logo_src() %}{% endif -%}
{{ _("Leave Form") }}
{{ _("Leave Application ID") }}: {{ doc.name }}
{{ _("Employee Details") }}
{{ _("Employee") }} {{ doc.employee or "" }} {{ _("Employee Name") }} {{ doc.employee_name or "" }}
{{ _("Department") }} {{ doc.department or "" }} {{ _("Project Allocation") }} {{ doc.custom_project_allocation or "" }}
{{ _("Emergency Contact Number") }} {{ doc.custom_emergency_contact_number or "" }}
{#- AC: signed by hand after printing, so it is left blank and names nobody. -#}
{{ _("Leave Details") }}
{{ _("Leave Type") }} {{ doc.leave_type or "" }}
{{ _("From Date") }} {{ frappe.format(doc.from_date, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.from_date else "" }} {{ _("To Date") }} {{ frappe.format(doc.to_date, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.to_date else "" }}
{{ _("Resumption Date") }} {{ frappe.format(doc.resumption_date, {"fieldtype": "Date"}) if doc.resumption_date else "" }}{{ _("Employee Signature") }}
{{ _("Leave Balance") }}
{{ _("Leave Balance Before Application") }} {{ doc.leave_balance if doc.leave_balance is not none else "" }}
{{ _("Total Leave Days") }} {{ doc.total_leave_days if doc.total_leave_days is not none else "" }}
{#- AC: the approver and HR sign the printed copy, so neither box names anybody - any authorised person may sign it. Nothing is fetched from the workflow here on purpose. -#}
{{ _("Signatures") }}
{{ _("Approver Signature") }} {{ _("HR Signature") }}
name: Leave Form
